assumptions: An authored M2 regional example. Source connections and ledge drawings constrain adjacency; physical rises are chosen, not recovered from gameplay elevation bits.
Preserve the existing Route 101 two-ledge profile: Littleroot is 0 px and Oldale is 16 px.
Route 102's central terrace rises to 24 px and its southern pocket drops to 8 px; the Oldale and Petalburg approaches meet at 16 px.
Route 103's western approach rises from 16 to 24 to 32 px. Complete coastal cliffs and Petalburg city geography remain unfinished.

Petalburg and Route 102 ponds and Route 103 ocean water are authored at a level 16 px, with one cell of flat shore contact. Water behaviors identify material, not height; source guards protect the selected areas. Water has no solid underside or vertical water walls.
Each short ledge tapers where its two sides meet around an endpoint. Open paths are graded by shared corners; no stair artwork or gameplay collision is invented.
